title: Shang chi
description: This project adds 10 rings from the movie shang chi
body:
NOTE:-
Both texture pack and data pack are provided in versions section make sure to keep resource file in resource folder and datapack file in datapack folder

CONTROLS:-
press F to cycle through abilities

OVERVIEW
This datapack/resourcepack adds alien Makluan rings with 7 abilities!
To obtain the rings kill a wandering trader, evoker, ender dragon, wither, piglin brute, vex, shulker, elder guardian, ravager, and phantom.
Each ring dropped will have specific stats relating to it's mob. The ender dragon will also drop a spark of life, which upon being consumed will power up the ten rings!

POWERS
Power Jump:
By flinging 2 rings behind you, you are propelled forward(if they hit a block). This propulsion is correlated to distance, so the longer the rings have to travel, the less they push you.
Speed Dash:
The only ability costing that uses no rings, Speed Dash gives you a burst of speed of half a second. Of course this can be repeatedly used to create a sustained boost.
Block Smash:
By shooting out 1 ring, you can break a block you are looking at.
Ring Slam:
Like Block Smash, Ring Slam shoots out 1 ring. In this case, though it can curve through the air in the direction you look and seeks out mobs in a small radius around it.
Chain Grab:
Can be paired with Ring Slam well, Chain grab uses 5 rings to latch onto a mob a great distance away. If you immediately use Ring Slam after Chain Grab, you can deal MASSIVE damage and knockback!
Nova:
In a quick burst, 8 rings surround you and deal massive damage to nearby mobs.
Energy Shield:
For sustained protection, 8 rings encompass you giving you resistance and knocking back enemies. Lasts about 3.5 seconds
